label: Blinded
title: Blinded
text: Can't see; auto-fails checks that need sight. Attacks against you have Advantage; your attacks have Disadvantage.

label: Charmed
title: Charmed
text: Can't attack the charmer or target them with harmful abilities or magic. The charmer has Advantage on social checks against you.

label: Deafened
title: Deafened
text: Can't hear; auto-fails checks that need hearing.

label: Exhaustion
title: Exhaustion
text: Each level: -2 to D20 Tests and -5 ft Speed. Die at level 6. A Long Rest removes 1 level.

label: Frightened
title: Frightened
text: Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks while the source of fear is in line of sight. Can't willingly move closer to it.

label: Grappled
title: Grappled
text: Speed 0. Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but the grappler. The grappler can drag or carry you.

label: Incapacitated
title: Incapacitated
text: No actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions. Concentration broken. Can't speak. Disadvantage on Initiative.

label: Invisible
title: Invisible
text: Attacks against you have Disadvantage; your attacks have Advantage. Advantage on Initiative. Not seen without special senses.

label: Paralyzed
title: Paralyzed
text: Incapacitated, Speed 0. Auto-fail Str and Dex saves. Attacks against you have Advantage; a hit from within 5 ft is a Critical Hit.

label: Petrified
title: Petrified
text: Turned to stone. Incapacitated, Speed 0. Auto-fail Str and Dex saves. Attacks against you have Advantage. Resistance to all damage; immune to Poisoned.

label: Poisoned
title: Poisoned
text: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

label: Prone
title: Prone
text: You can only crawl, or spend half your Speed to stand. Disadvantage on attacks. Attacks against you have Advantage from within 5 ft, otherwise Disadvantage.

label: Restrained
title: Restrained
text: Speed 0. Attacks against you have Advantage; your attacks have Disadvantage. Disadvantage on Dex saves.

label: Stunned
title: Stunned
text: Incapacitated. Auto-fail Str and Dex saves. Attacks against you have Advantage.

label: Unconscious
title: Unconscious
text: Incapacitated, Prone, Speed 0; drops what it holds. Auto-fail Str and Dex saves. Attacks have Advantage; a hit from within 5 ft is a Critical Hit.

label: Half Cover
title: Half Cover
text: +2 bonus to AC and Dex saves.

label: Three-Quarters Cover
title: Three-Quarters Cover
text: +5 bonus to AC and Dex saves.

label: Total Cover
title: Total Cover
text: Can't be targeted directly by attacks or spells.

label: Advantage / Disadvantage
title: Advantage & Disadvantage
text: Roll two d20s: take the higher (Advantage) or lower (Disadvantage). Multiple sources don't stack; any of each cancels out.

label: Death Saves
title: Death Saving Throws
text: d20 at 0 HP: 10+ succeeds. 3 successes stabilize, 3 failures die. Natural 20: regain 1 HP. Natural 1: two failures.

label: Concentration
title: Concentration
text: When damaged: Con save, DC 10 or half the damage (whichever is higher, max 30). Fail and the spell ends.

label: Opportunity Attack
title: Opportunity Attack
text: Reaction: one melee attack when a creature you can see leaves your reach without Disengaging.

label: Dodge
title: Dodge
text: Until your next turn: attacks against you have Disadvantage (if you can see the attacker) and you have Advantage on Dex saves.

label: Help
title: Help
text: Give an ally Advantage on their next ability check or attack roll against a creature within 5 ft of you.

label: Grapple / Shove
title: Grapple & Shove
text: Unarmed Strike option. Target's Str or Dex save vs DC 8 + Str mod + Proficiency. Grapple: Grappled. Shove: Prone or pushed 5 ft.

label: Short / Long Rest
title: Rests
text: Short Rest: 1 hour, spend Hit Dice to heal. Long Rest: 8 hours, regain all HP and half your Hit Dice.
